authority_change.instruction: 의존성 변경해도돼, 필요한 패키지나 프레임워크 등등 제한하지 않고 공식해커톤 규칙만 준수한다면 직접 설치해도 돼, 승인할게 문서내용도 변경해

new_rule: Absence is no longer a rejection reason. A candidate needing torch, a probabilistic-boosting package, a conformal library, or pretrained weights is now INSTALLABLE and must be judged on evidence and cost, not availability. Every install is pinned and recorded.
install_conditions: install into the project .venv, never system packages
pin the exact resolved version in the node receipt
the pipeline must be reproducible from submitted code alone
no package may be used for remote API model inference
pretrained weights require release on or before 2026-07-05 and a licence permitting use, modification, distribution, redistribution and commercial use

reopened_axes.root_requirement: verify verbatim licence text for redistribution and commercial use before any download

reopened_axes.note: Prior Labs License v1.1 reported as an Apache-2.0 derivative with no field-of-use restriction; root must read the verbatim licence and confirm redistribution before use. TabPFN-2.5 is INELIGIBLE (non-commercial).

torch is installable, but the V5-MODELS additivity argument (componentwise Bayes actions under an additive objective) independently caps what sequence/graph structure can contribute. Justify any such rung on distributional-estimation grounds, not architecture.
ngboost/lightgbmlss/xgboostlss/mapie/crepes are installable; the underlying algorithms also remain implementable in numpy.

reopened_axes.axis: external public data with per-row basis-time availability
reopened_axes.note: The withdrawn 2026-07-05 blanket cutoff for DATA no longer applies. Any public archive whose issue/publication timestamps provably precede each D-1 14:00 KST basis time is admissible, subject to licence, public access, reproducibility and the standing reanalysis/post-hoc-correction ban.

unchanged_prohibitions: remote compute and git push without separate authority
